critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2205 lines — still grows monotonically each iteration. Split into a routes/ package (push, contact, pages, orders, admin_collections, etc.).

The best-seller ordering uses manual-sort HACK handles: GHK-Cu ships as '1-ghk-cu', TB-500 as 'fgtb-500', hGH-frag as 'axchgh-frag-176-191'. Product handles should be the human/canonical slug and manual ordering should live only in collections_cat.product_order (which already exists). These prefixed handles will confuse SEO, sitemaps, redirects and any external links that expect the real handle.

Contact endpoint sends the raw user-supplied name/message directly into an HTML email body without HTML-escaping (server.py:1884-1889). A malicious visitor could inject arbitrary HTML/links into the admin's inbox. Wrap payload.name/message with html.escape() before formatting.

notify_admin_push() is fire-and-forget inside contact_form and inside checkout — but the push_service.send() call is not gathered / not shielded. If pywebpush blocks (e.g. FCM slow), the checkout response time grows. Consider asyncio.create_task with a timeout.

PushSubscriptionIn.expirationTime is camelCase which is fine for the browser payload, but everywhere else in the codebase snake_case is used — kept for wire compatibility, worth a comment.
